title: Provider error normalized
description: Shows a synthetic provider error normalized into a receipt-safe terminal event.
prompt: Return a short synthetic provider error demonstration without exposing provider payloads.

evidence.claim: Arbiter converts the provider failure into safe execution evidence without raw upstream details.
highlights: The error code is stable and public-safe.
Raw provider responses remain outside the demo artifact.
The console can explain the failure without sensitive details.
